svg.aria-label: Also on the bench: btbt and beanThere MERN storefronts with a neo-brutalist UI (live), Noteify (MERN notes app from 10Pearls), faizkhan.tech (live), Figma-to-code builds of an NFT site, Rappi and neoFi (live), an Internee.pk landing page clone, and small tools: chat UI, weather app, file uploader and multi-step forms.
